scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names client,server "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
scripts.verify: npm run check --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client && npm run test && npm run build:client
